entries.title: Exact candidate-list SL@20 with fullY coverage weight
entries.novelty_delta: Exact fixedC top20 threshold and explicit fullY denominator-ratio weighting, not generic Lambda/Yeti/XE or sampled/fullCE axis
entries.counter: Score-dependent positive weighting suppresses hard/new true purchases; little signal with one positive
entries.inputs: same compact B41 row scorer on fixedC; training fullY cardinality is label, not feature
entries.assumption_gap: paper nonzeroDCG and one/multiple-hit distinctions, catalog quantiles/sampling; frequent zeroY/zeroCoverage and smallC violate direct guarantee transfer

entries.cheapest_falsification: literal0/1/2positive, shortC/tied/partialCoverage lists and hard-positive gradient direction

entries.title: FullC closure versus teacher-top20 subset distillation
entries.novelty_delta: Teacher/student subset closure and dense soft-label transfer, not frozen hybrid embeddings or auxiliary065
entries.counter: Copies B errors/in-sample overfit; B inference may already be cheap
entries.inputs: same B41 student; existing sealed B teacher scores on same fixedC
entries.assumption_gap: CF teacher/student large item universes; exact fullC closure is practical here so RCE sampling not required
entries.teacher_fit_policy: zero new teacher fits if existing lifecycle valid; otherwise teacher consumes attempt and control removal must be prospective or defer

entries.cheapest_falsification: literal closure counterexample, explicit teacher lifecycle and real inference-bottleneck gate before fits
